blurb: Island Bound Adventures offers fun and educational sailing experiences including private charters, special event cruises, and ASA-certified sailing courses. They provide training from beginner to advanced levels, including preparation for U.S. Coast Guard licenses. Services include local lake sailing, blue water adventures, and Caribbean cruises.
